name: Villa Mani
insider_take: This intimate 8-suite oceanfront villa feels more like a private estate than a hotel, where you'll have direct access to the pristine Grace Bay Beach—consistently ranked among the world's best.
whats_special: Villa Mani sits on Grace Bay's coveted beachfront with only 8 luxury suites, ensuring an ultra-exclusive experience. The property features a private chef, personalized butler service, and sits within walking distance of the famous Conch Bar Caves—one of the Caribbean's largest cave systems with stunning stalactite formations.
pro_tip: Book the rooftop terrace for sunset cocktails—you'll have unobstructed views of Grace Bay's turquoise waters and some of the most spectacular sunsets in the Caribbean, all while enjoying complete privacy.
dont_miss: Take a short trip to nearby Chalk Sound National Park, where you'll find an otherworldly lagoon filled with dozens of tiny islands and water so blue it looks artificial. The contrast between the limestone islands and electric blue water creates one of the most photographed spots in Turks & Caicos.
pros: Stunning beachfront location with pristine white sand beach access
Luxurious villa-style accommodations with private pools and terraces
Exceptional personalized service and attention to detail
World-class spa and wellness facilities with ocean views
cons: Remote island location requires flight connections
This property is not available for online booking.
